properties.description: Bounding box for ZIP code 81008; used as frame for North Pueblo research.
properties.notes: Desktop mapping uses bounding box because public polygon data requires shapefiles.

properties.name: Pueblo Police Department / Real-Time Crime Center
properties.description: Public Safety Complex hosting RTCC with ShotSpotter (6 sq mi), drones, Daktronics video wall, Community Connect intake. Operating 10am-midnight, expanding to 24/7.

properties.name: Drone as First Responder (DFR) Station
properties.description: First DFR station launched July 2025. Drones deployed to RTCC before officers arrive. Part of Pueblo's expanding aerial surveillance network.

properties.name: Downtown Flock ALPR Installations
properties.description: Pueblo Downtown Association-funded Flock Safety cameras covering Union Ave / Riverwalk corridors. 30-day cloud retention. Part of 1,091-camera Colorado network.
properties.notes: EFF Nov 2025 report documents Flock network used to surveil protesters nationwide.

properties.name: Mobile Camera Trailer - Mesa & Elm
properties.description: Solar-powered mobile RTCC camera trailer at Mesa Ave & Elm St. One of four mobile trailers deployed citywide. Captured Aug 2025 homicide footage.
properties.notes: Location approximate based on news reporting. Trailers are mobile and may relocate.

properties.name: Pueblo Mall private security office
properties.description: North-side retail hub with on-site security office. Potential Community Connect participant in ZIP 81008.

properties.name: Pueblo County Sheriff's Office HQ
properties.description: 909 Court Street command campus. Sheriff Lucero issued Jan 2025 statement limiting ICE cooperation. All 73 patrol cars now equipped with mobile Flock ALPRs (March 2025). Mobile ALPRs feed into RTCC.

properties.name: Catholic Charities Immigration Services
properties.description: Safe walk-in site at 429 W 10th St offering DOJ-accredited immigration legal aid, Know Your Rights briefings. Phone: (719) 586-8600.

properties.name: Mineral Palace Park
properties.description: One of 5 parks with RTCC-connected surveillance infrastructure (cameras, ALPRs, Wi-Fi, fiber). Funded by $1M+ ARPA allocation. Community staging zone for events like Pueblo Pride.
sources: City of Pueblo ARPA spending reports
properties.notes: Good rally point with sight lines away from downtown RTCC clusters. Surveillance cameras active 24/7, feeds to RTCC.

properties.name: Posada of Pueblo
properties.description: Emergency housing, homeless services, youth programs. Address: 501 Belmont Ave. Phone: 719-545-8776.

properties.name: Colorado Legal Services - Pueblo Office
properties.description: Free legal aid for eviction defense, immigration screenings, protection orders. Address: 1000 W 6th St. Phone: 719-545-6708.

properties.name: Mariposa Center for Safety (YWCA)
properties.description: 24/7 DV crisis line, emergency shelter, legal advocacy. Address: 801 N Santa Fe Ave. Crisis line: 719-545-8195.

properties.name: Pueblo Community Health Center
properties.description: FQHC accepting all patients regardless of ability to pay. Homeless clinic, migrant health services. Phone: (719) 543-8711.

properties.name: Health Solutions Crisis Walk-In Center
properties.description: 24/7 mental health crisis stabilization, mobile crisis response, peer support, detox coordination. No insurance required. Address: 711 W 13th St. Phone: 844-493-8255.

properties.name: Juniper Southern Colorado (formerly Rape Crisis Services)
properties.description: 24/7 crisis hotline (call OR text), hospital/court accompaniment, long-term case management, counseling referrals. Address: 503 N Main St, Suite 526. Crisis line: 719-549-0549 (call/text).

properties.name: Pueblo City-County Library - Rawlings Branch
properties.description: Main library with TechConnect program: free Wi-Fi hotspot/Chromebook loans, printing, digital literacy help. Address: 100 E Abriendo Ave. Phone: 719-562-5600.

properties.name: Pueblo Cooperative Care Center
properties.description: Food, clothing, hygiene kits, mail services for residents in crisis. Address: 326 W 8th St. Phone: 719-543-7484.

properties.name: Pueblo County Courthouse
properties.description: Location to monitor for ICE civil arrest activity. Nov 2025 federal ruling prohibits ICE warrantless arrests in Colorado. Address: 215 W 10th St.
properties.notes: Log observations in data/immigration_ice_raw.md with date, time, agency, badge numbers if visible.

properties.name: ShotSpotter Eastside Coverage
properties.description: Primary ShotSpotter deployment (~2 sq mi). Sensors on buildings and poles. 60-second alert to RTCC. Part of $210k/year SoundThinking contract.
properties.notes: Coverage area is approximate - exact sensor locations not public. Chicago IG found 89% of ShotSpotter alerts led to no gun-related incident.

properties.name: ShotSpotter Bessemer Coverage
properties.description: Expanded ShotSpotter coverage (~1 sq mi). Added July 2025 after March officer shooting. Extends into previously unmonitored Bessemer/Southside area.
properties.notes: Expansion funded by state grant. Almost exclusively deployed in low-income Black/Latino neighborhoods.

properties.name: Union Avenue ALPR Corridor
properties.description: Flock Safety license plate reader corridor along Union Avenue. Downtown Association funded initial deployment. Part of 1,091-camera Colorado network. 30-day cloud retention.
properties.notes: EFF documented this network used for protest surveillance. Audit logs should be requested via CORA.

properties.name: Riverwalk ALPR Corridor
properties.description: Flock Safety license plate reader coverage along Riverwalk area. Connected to Downtown Association surveillance initiative.
properties.notes: Part of downtown surveillance ring. Cameras capture all plates, not just hotlist matches.

properties.name: Colorado State University Pueblo
properties.description: Major employer and institution. Potential march/protest staging area. Has campus police. Located near ALPR coverage zones.
properties.notes: University grounds are limited public forum - different First Amendment rules may apply for non-students.

properties.name: Pueblo Community College
properties.description: Major employer. Commissioner McPheeters works in grant compliance here. Mobile food pantry first Tuesday of each month.
properties.notes: Potential conflict of interest for commissioner votes on education-related surveillance.

properties.name: El Centro del Quinto Sol Recreation Center
properties.description: Free drop-in activities, after-school programs, tutoring, safe community space. Address: 609 E 6th St. Phone: 719-553-2949.
properties.notes: Good community meeting space. CSU-Pueblo Learning Center on-site.
